adaptation: At least four real supplier-review agents run concurrently in separate sandboxes over one persistent cache. Unlike the reproduction's seeded notes or derived outputs, V11 starts with no peer content: only real subject actions create method-redacted operational receipts. A blocked task becomes solvable if a peer independently discovers and shares the retained-collection scope. The primary gate requires an agent-initiated ask, exact receipt, a different agent's working reply, and a fresh agent's exact receipt and use while all four execution intervals overlap.
